name: Carousel (web component)
summary: Browse a small set of slides by swipe, arrows, dots or keys in the carousel look, without antd.
highlights: No cloned slides: every id and image exists once
The element owns the position: index, the dots and the spoken position move together
change at the start of a move, after-change at the end, each fired once
lead: ONE custom element, <aha-carousel>, defined once and imported unchanged by React and Vue: the framework-free counterpart of the antd Carousel, so an app can drop antd and slick for its carousels. It draws what the shared carouselTheme draws (16x4 grey 70 rest dots, a 28 wide brand active dot, 8 between them). Each child element is one slide. There are no cloned slides, so an id or a form field in a slide exists once, and slides that are not showing are inert, so Tab and a screen reader skip them. The element owns the position: `index` moves as a move starts, together with the dots, the arrows and a polite live region that says "Item 2 of 5", so a screen needs no state of its own to announce where the person is. `change` fires once with the destination as a move starts, `after-change` fires once when the track comes to rest. Swipe or drag, the arrows (`arrows`), the dots, or the Left and Right keys on any control all move it. Autoplay, fade and vertical dots stay on the antd Carousel composite.
codeNote: antd Carousel → <aha-carousel>: children → child elements, each one slide (no wrapper div is needed) · arrows → arrows · dots → on by default, dots="false" removes them · adaptiveHeight → adaptive-height · infinite → loop, off by default: without it the ends stop and the arrow there turns disabled; add it to keep antd's default wrap (the track runs back across the slides, because nothing is cloned) · initialSlide → index · beforeChange(from, to) → the `change` event, e.detail = { index, from } · afterChange(current) → the `after-change` event, e.detail = { index }; a second press during a move gives one after-change, for where the track came to rest · goTo(i) / next() / prev() → the same methods; they fire both events, and setting `index` moves the track silently · prevArrow / nextArrow → prev-label and next-label: the arrows are always <aha-button> with the caret glyphs, which flip right to left · customPaging → the `dotLabel` property, a function (position, total) => string, position counting from 1 · a hand-built role="status" region → the `positionText` property, same signature, or nothing for the default · reading the position → `carousel.index`, zero-based, and `carousel.count`; there is no need for React state to name the dots or to drive aria-current · autoplay, fade, dotPosition, vertical, speed: not supported, use the antd Carousel composite. React 18: set the function properties through a ref and listen with ref.current.addEventListener('change' | 'after-change', …), since React 18 does not wire CustomEvents; pass a boolean as present or absent ({...(loop ? { loop: '' } : {})}). A native change event from a field inside a slide also bubbles through the element, so check e.target === e.currentTarget if a slide holds a form. React 19 can use the element directly. Vue binds it natively (:index.prop, :dot-label.prop, @change, @after-change).

spec.label: Slide
spec.value: each child element fills the width; the track clips to radius 8. The element paints no slide fill: the slide owns what is on it

spec.label: Rest dot
spec.value: 16×4, #8A8A8A (gray-70, 3.45:1 on white), pill ends; #616161 (gray-80) on hover, #4A4A4A (gray-90) pressed

spec.label: Active dot
spec.value: 28 wide, brand #E70E68; #DB005B (color-primary-hover) on hover and pressed; aria-current="true"

spec.label: Dot row
spec.value: under the slides, centred, 8 from them and 8 between dots; each dot is a 24px tall target and the row wraps. Under, not over: grey 70 on a photograph has no contrast to rely on

spec.label: Focus
spec.value: 2px #E70E68 ring (focus-ring), 2px off the dot; the arrows carry the Button ring

spec.label: Arrows
spec.value: opt-in via arrows: <aha-button variant="secondary" size="lg" icon-only>, 40px with the 16px carets, on a white backing with a soft shadow so they read on any slide, including the Button's translucent hover; 12 from the sides, centred on the slide. Disabled at the ends unless loop is set, and focus moves to the other arrow

spec.label: Height
spec.value: the tallest slide's; with adaptive-height the showing slide's, animated and following a late image load

spec.label: Motion
spec.value: .3s (motion-slow) ease-out on the track and the height; instant under prefers-reduced-motion, and the events still fire

spec.label: Swipe
spec.value: sideways past 72px, or a quarter of the width if smaller, or a flick; otherwise it springs back. Past the first or last slide the drag resists to 30%. Vertical movement and pinch zoom stay with the page. A drag that starts on a field, a slider or a media control in a slide is left to it; one that starts on a link or button moves the track and does not click it, and a press stays a click

spec.label: One slide, none
spec.value: one slide shows no arrows, no dots and no spoken position, and does not drag; no slides collapses to nothing, so show <aha-empty> in its place

spec.label: Right to left
spec.value: in a dir="rtl" context (the attribute, not CSS direction) the slides run from the right, swipes reverse, ArrowLeft / ArrowRight swap and the caret glyphs flip

spec.label: From antd
spec.value: the same dots under carouselTheme, moved out from over the slide; infinite becomes loop, beforeChange becomes change, afterChange becomes after-change, customPaging becomes dotLabel

props.name: index
props.desc: The showing slide, zero-based and clamped; the attribute is its string and follows every move. Setting it moves the track and fires no event

props.name: arrows
props.desc: Show the previous and next arrows; arrows="false" reads as off

props.name: dots
props.desc: dots="false" removes the dots; without arrows either, give the screen its own controls through goTo()

props.name: loop
props.desc: Wrap at the ends (antd infinite). Nothing is cloned, so the track runs back across the slides

props.name: adaptive-height
props.desc: The height follows the showing slide (antd adaptiveHeight)

props.name: prev-label / next-label
props.desc: Name the arrows; override to translate, or to name the content ("Previous image")

props.name: dotLabel
props.desc: Names one dot (antd customPaging); a property, position counting from 1. Override to translate

props.name: positionText
props.desc: The polite live region's text after each move; a property, position counting from 1. Override to translate

props.name: aria-label / aria-labelledby
props.desc: Name the carousel's group; aria-labelledby ids are resolved to their text across the shadow root

props.name: goTo(index) / next() / prev()
props.desc: Move as the user does and fire both events; goTo clamps to the slides there are. Each returns whether a move started

props.name: change
props.desc: Fires once on the element as a move starts, with the destination already in `index` (antd beforeChange). It does not bubble, so a form or tabs around the carousel never read it as their own. A native change from a field in a slide does bubble through, so check e.target === carousel

props.name: after-change
props.desc: Composed; fires once when the track comes to rest, for analytics (antd afterChange). A second press during a move gives one after-change, for the slide it rested on

a11y.role: the carousel is a named role="group"; the active dot has aria-current="true"; slides that are not showing are inert; a polite live region says the position after each move
a11y.keyboard: on an arrow or a dot, ArrowLeft / ArrowRight step (they swap right to left) and Home / End jump to the first and last; the dots are one tab stop and focus follows the active dot. Keys pressed inside a slide stay with the slide. If a move takes focus off the slide it was in, focus lands on the carousel, so Tab carries on from the showing slide
a11y.note: Name the carousel with aria-label or aria-labelledby. Say what the slides are in the labels ("Next image", "Go to image 2 of 5", "Image 2 of 5").

whenToUse.when: a small, ordered set of equally weighted panels browsed at the person's own pace: a gallery, a feature tour, on a screen moving off antd
autoplay, a fade, dots on the side, or an antd screen not moving off antd yet
named sections the person jumps between directly, not in sequence
a linear process with a clear start and finish
a row of chips or cards where several show at once

opinion.note: Keep it to a handful of slides and keep the dots, so people know there is more. Name what the slides are in the labels: "Next image" says more than "Next item". A carousel showing deck slides overrides the labels back to "slide" ("Next slide").
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — the DS V3 Carousel look as carouselTheme renders it on antd v6 (dots, active dot, focus ring), with the Button for the arrows.
